publication_policy: Without reliably timed proof of release, document dated D unlocks no earlier than 00:00 KST on D+1.
unknown_publication_date: Do not show until manually verified.
post_release_revisions: Archive/version-lock. A current document must never be substituted for a historical revision.
locked_future_behavior: Do NOT show individual hidden future documents, titles, counts or dates. Show only currently known documents.
user_choice: The user sees researched risks and may trade, sell, keep or rebalance independently; the underlying AI signal logic remains private.
